documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for BOARD MEETING TO BE HELD ON 04.11.2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Disclosures under Reg. 29(2) of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Thangamayil Jewellery Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for the financial year 2025-26, driven by robust top-line growth, successful Chennai metro expansion, and disciplined cost and inventory management. Total revenue for the year stood at Rs. 849,933 lakhs, with EBITDA at Rs. 57,674 lakhs and PAT at Rs. 35,165 lakhs, reflecting significant year-on-year increases.

guidance.claim: Management plans to nearly double the top line in the next four years.
guidance.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

guidance.claim: The customer base is slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by March 31, 2026.
guidance.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

guidance.claim: The management plans to open a flagship Chennai outlet by January 2025.
guidance.quote: • To open flagship Chennai outlet by Jan 2025.

guidance.claim: The company targets to complete geographical expansion in an additional 9 outlets approved by the Board.
guidance.quote: • To complete geographical expansion in additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.

guidance.claim: Management aims to further improve high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales.
guidance.quote: • Further improve the high value product-mix composition by 2% to 10% on overall sales

guidance.claim: The company targets to improve stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.
guidance.quote: • Improve the stock turnaround from 3.52 times to 3.75 times.

guidance.claim: Management plans to improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.
guidance.quote: • Improve the gross profit margin from 9.64% to 10% on price rationalisation.

guidance.claim: The company targets Same Store Sales improvement of at least 10% over and above the current level.
guidance.quote: • SSS improvement at least by 10% over and above current level.

demand_outlook.claim: The vertical rise in gold price restricts sales as customers are unsure about the sustenance of prices, creating short-run slowness in off-take.
demand_outlook.quote: The adverse impact on vertical rise in gold price restricts the sale by the company as customers are not sure about the sustenance of price • Being a temporary phenomenon in the short run, it would naturally have slowness in off take

demand_outlook.claim: Sharp price corrections may induce customer purchases while protecting the company from pronounced inventory loss.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, any sharp price corrections may induce purchases from the customers while protecting the company from any pronounced inventory loss

capex_expansion.claim: Capital work in progress amount outstanding as on 31st March 2024 is Rs. 236 lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: The capital work in progress amount outstanding as on 31st March 2024 is `236 lakhs (previous year `160 lakhs).

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA as a percentage of revenue for the year 2025-26 was 6.79%.
The company experienced a customs duty hit of Rs. 1,547 lakhs taken in the second quarter of FY 24-25.
margins_costs.quote: Above all, customs duty hit of 1,547 lakhs taken in the second quarter of 24-25 FY also aff ected the overall PBT by that amount.

margins_costs.claim: Employee benefit expenses increased by Rs. 250 lakhs due to new recruits for proposed Chennai-based retail outlets.
margins_costs.quote: Further, employee benefi t expenses increased by new recruits for proposed Chennai based retail outlets amounting to 250 lakhs also added to the reduction in the PBT

margins_costs.claim: On a retail revenue growth of 28%, costs were managed to improve only by 10% through cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization done. On a retail revenue growth of 28% the cost managed to improve only by 10%

orders_capacity.claim: Retail space increased by 17.46% to reach 1,04,000 sq. ft. during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: Retail Space (increases by 17.46%) 104000 sq ft 88000 sq ft 18%

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued a Rights Issue raising gross proceeds of Rs. 5,10,000 lakhs, which was successfully subscribed and allotted.
capital_allocation.quote: The issue was successfully subscribed, and allotment were made on 07/03/25 to all the eligible shareholders • The Rights issue, gross amount of 5,10,000 lakhs was taken to reserves net of issue expenses of 224 lakhs

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the Rights Issue sum of Rs. 50,776 lakhs, only Rs. 2,924 lakhs remained unutilized as on May 14, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of the said sum of 50,776 lakhs only a sum of 2,924 lakhs remaining unutilized as on 14/05/25, All the formalities governing the monitoring of the utilisation of the funds collected are complied with.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 6 per share of face value of Rs. 10 aggregating to Rs. 10 per share total distribution for FY2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board after considering the funding requirements for 2024-25 both for capex and enlarged working capital requirements due to gold price increase by 12%, has recommended a final dividend of ` 6/- per share of face value of Rs.10/- aggregating to Rs.10/- per share as total distribution of dividend for the financial year 2023-24 on the doubled equity capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted continued unhealthy competition prevailing in the market as overall volume size shrinks modestly.
risks_headwinds.quote: Continued unhealthy competition prevailing in the market as the over all size of the market in volume terms shrinking modestly.

risks_headwinds.claim: An extraordinary shift is taking place among the younger population for other discretionary spending.
risks_headwinds.quote: Extra ordinary shift is taking place among younger population for other discretionary spending.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company noted continued unhealthy competition prevailing among both unorganised and organised players.
risks_headwinds.quote: Continued unhealthy competition prevailing both in unorganised and organised players.

management_commitments.quote: Plan to nearly double the top line in the next four years that took us 25 years to be where we are now.

management_commitments.claim: The customer base is slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by March 31, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Excellent Customer base built over period of years up to 32 Lakhs numbers and slated to increase to 40 Lakhs by 31/03/26

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open a flagship Chennai outlet by January 2025.
management_commitments.quote: • To open flagship Chennai outlet by Jan 2025.

management_commitments.quote: • To complete geographical expansion in additional 9 outlets as approved by the Board.
